custom_panel.title: Custom Panel
custom_panel.plugin_missing: The plugin that owns this panel is disabled, broken or removed.

crash.unknown_advice: Expand the key log lines below, or export a crash report and send it to someone who can help.
crash.help_hint: When asking for help, send the exported crash report rather than a screenshot of this window.

jvm_args_invalid.title: Invalid JVM arguments
jvm_args_invalid.advice: Check the extra JVM and game arguments in the instance and global settings for typos.

mod_extracted.title: A mod was extracted
mod_extracted.advice: Mods must stay as .jar files in the mods folder. Delete the extracted folders and put the original jar files back.

mixin_bootstrap_missing.title: MixinBootstrap is missing
mixin_bootstrap_missing.advice: Install MixinBootstrap. If it still crashes, add an exclamation mark to the start of its file name so it loads first.

out_of_memory.title: Out of memory
out_of_memory.advice: The game may not have enough memory assigned, the computer may be low on free memory, or resource packs, mods or shaders may be too demanding. Increase the game memory, close other programs and remove heavy resources.

using_jdk.title: JDK or a too-new Java is in use
using_jdk.advice: This game version needs Java 8. Switch to Java 8 under "Java runtime" in the instance settings, or set it back to automatic.

opengl_unsupported.title: The graphics card doesn't support OpenGL
opengl_unsupported.advice: Update the graphics driver. On laptops, make sure the game runs on the dedicated GPU.

openj9.title: OpenJ9 is in use
openj9.advice: Minecraft doesn't support the OpenJ9 VM. Switch to another Java (e.g. Adoptium or Zulu) under "Java runtime" in the instance settings.

java_too_new.title: Java is too new
java_too_new.advice: This game or loader version doesn't work with the current Java. Switch to an older Java under "Java runtime" in the instance settings, or set it back to automatic.

java_incompatible.title: Incompatible Java version
java_incompatible.advice: The game or a mod needs a different Java version. Set "Java runtime" in the instance settings back to automatic, or use the version listed below.

mod_name_special_chars.title: A mod file name contains special characters
mod_name_special_chars.advice: Rename the mod file so it only contains letters, digits, hyphens, underscores and dots.

graphics_driver.title: Graphics driver problem
graphics_driver.advice: Update the graphics driver to the latest version (or roll it back to the factory version), then launch again.

integrated_graphics.title: Graphics driver problem, or the dedicated GPU isn't used
integrated_graphics.advice: The game seems to run on Intel integrated graphics. If the computer has a dedicated GPU, assign it to Java in the GPU control panel or Windows graphics settings; otherwise update the driver.

short_output.title: The program printed the following
short_output.advice: The game exited almost without output. This is everything it printed.

debug_crash.title: This is a manually triggered debug crash
debug_crash.advice: Nothing is wrong with the game: holding F3 + C crashes it on purpose for debugging.

opengl_1282.title: A shader or resource pack caused an OpenGL error
opengl_1282.advice: Remove recently added shader packs or resource packs and try again.

file_verification.title: File verification failed
file_verification.advice: Some game or mod files are corrupted. Repair the files in the instance settings, or download the broken mod again.

mod_crashed.title: A mod crashed the game
mod_crashed.advice: The mod below caused the error. Disable it to see whether the game still crashes, then look for a newer version.

mod_suspected.title: A mod probably crashed the game
mod_suspected.advice: The mods below may have caused the error, but it isn't certain. Disable them one at a time to find out.

mod_config.title: A mod's config file is broken
mod_config.advice: The config file of the mod below can't be read. Delete that config file and the game will create a new one.

mod_mixin.title: A mod failed to inject
mod_mixin.advice: This usually means the mod doesn't work with other mods, the game version or the loader version, or it has a bug. Disable the mod below or try another version.

loader_error.title: The mod loader reported an error
loader_error.advice: The mod loader gave the message below. Follow its instructions.

mod_init_failed.title: A mod failed to initialize
mod_init_failed.advice: The mod below couldn't initialize, so the game can't continue loading. Disable it to see whether the game still crashes.

stack_keyword.title: Suspicious keywords found in the error
stack_keyword.advice: If you know which mod one of these keywords belongs to, that mod probably caused the error. Expand the key log lines for details.

optifine_world_load.title: OptiFine can't load the world
optifine_world_load.advice: This only happens with some OptiFine versions. Try another OptiFine version.

block_crash.title: A block in the world caused the crash
block_crash.advice: Try a new world: if it works, this block is the cause and needs to be removed; if not, the cause is something else.

entity_crash.title: An entity in the world caused the crash
entity_crash.advice: The entity below crashed the game. Try a new world to see whether it still crashes.

texture_too_large.title: Textures are too large or the GPU is too weak
texture_too_large.advice: Remove high-resolution resource packs. If you aren't using any, update the graphics driver.

no_logs.title: No logs found
no_logs.advice: The game left no log files to analyze. Export a crash report and send it to someone who can help.

java_32bit.title: 32-bit Java is in use
java_32bit.advice: 32-bit Java can't allocate the memory the game needs. Switch to a 64-bit Java in the settings, or set it back to automatic.

mod_duplicate.title: A mod is installed twice
mod_duplicate.advice: Each mod may only appear once. Delete the duplicates below and keep one version.

mod_incompatible.title: Mods are incompatible
mod_incompatible.advice: The mod loader found the problems below. Install, replace or remove the mods it mentions.

optifine_forge.title: OptiFine doesn't work with this Forge
optifine_forge.advice: Check which Forge version your OptiFine supports on https://optifine.net/downloads and reinstall with that version.

fabric_error.title: Fabric reported an error
fabric_error.advice: Fabric gave the message below. Follow its instructions.

fabric_solution.title: Fabric suggested a fix
fabric_solution.advice: Install, replace or remove the mods as described below.

forge_error.title: Forge reported an error
forge_error.advice: Forge gave the message below. Follow its instructions.

old_forge_new_java.title: Old Forge doesn't work with this Java
old_forge_new_java.advice: Update Forge to 36.2.26 or newer, or use a Java 8 older than 8u320.

multiple_forge.title: The version contains more than one Forge
multiple_forge.advice: Another launcher may have modified this version's Forge. Reinstall Forge.

id_limit.title: Too many mods: ID limit exceeded
id_limit.advice: Install a fix mod such as JEID, or remove some large mods.

night_config.title: Known Night Config bug
night_config.advice: Install the Night Config Fixes mod to work around it.

shaders_mod_optifine.title: OptiFine and Shaders Mod are both installed
shaders_mod_optifine.advice: OptiFine already includes shader support. Remove Shaders Mod.

forge_incomplete.title: Forge is incompletely installed
forge_incomplete.advice: Some Forge files are missing. Repair the files in the instance settings, or reinstall the same Forge version.

mod_needs_java11.title: A mod needs Java 11 or newer
mod_needs_java11.advice: Switch to Java 11 or newer under "Java runtime" in the instance settings.

mod_missing_dependency.title: Missing dependency, or a mod doesn't match the game version
mod_missing_dependency.advice: Install the dependencies listed below, or replace the mods with versions for this game version.

manual_close.title: The game was closed manually
manual_close.advice: The game was ended by closing its console or pressing Ctrl+C. It didn't crash.

not_responding.title: The game stopped responding and was ended
not_responding.advice: The game froze and was ended by Windows or from the "not responding" dialog. If it freezes often, give it more memory or use fewer mods and shaders.

terminated.title: The game process was ended
terminated.advice: There are no errors in the logs. The game was probably ended from Task Manager or by another program.

native_crash.title: The Java VM crashed
native_crash.advice: Java failed in native code. Common causes are graphics drivers and programs that inject into games, such as recorders or network boosters. Update the driver and close such programs.

java_not_found.title: No suitable Java found
java_not_found.advice: Turn on automatic Java downloads on the Java page of the global settings, or install the required 64-bit Java yourself.

java_invalid.title: The selected Java can't be used
java_invalid.advice: The Java chosen in the settings no longer exists or is broken. Choose another one, or set it back to automatic.

java_start_failed.title: The Java process couldn't start
java_start_failed.advice: Java may have been deleted, damaged or blocked by security software. Choose another Java, or allow the launcher in your security software.

download_failed.title: Download failed
download_failed.advice: Check your network connection, or pick another download source on the download page of the global settings and try again.

file_access_denied.title: A file is in use or access was denied
file_access_denied.advice: Another program (such as a running game or antivirus) may be using the file. Close it and try again, or use a game folder you can write to.

disk_full.title: Not enough disk space
disk_full.advice: Free up some disk space and try again.

file_corrupted.title: Game files are corrupted
file_corrupted.advice: The version files can't be read. Repair the files in the instance settings, or reinstall this version.

account_failed.title: Account verification failed
account_failed.advice: Sign in to this account again in account management.

instance_broken.title: The instance is incomplete
instance_broken.advice: This instance is missing required files. Repair the files in the instance settings, or reinstall this version.

path_invalid.title: The game path contains unsupported characters
path_invalid.advice: The game folder path can't contain semicolons or exclamation marks. Move the game to another folder.

update.title: Update Available
update.ready_desc: New version downloaded. Restart the launcher to apply.
